ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.5 Playtest carries forward the validated Butter++ manager-level logical-tick barrier and starts the next performance phase. PathGrid topology invalidation is deduplicated so nested cell recalculations and full-grid rebuilds no longer create generation storms that force excessive immutable path-snapshot rebuilds. JobGiver diagnostics now profile concrete WorkGiver phases by def/type to identify the scanners responsible for long TryIssueJobPackage spikes before any job logic is moved off-thread. Path A* remains immutable-snapshot shadow validation and vanilla PawnPath remains authoritative.
